name: sentry-crash-analysis
description: Systematic methodology for diagnosing GnollHack crash reports from the Sentry MCP server. Use when the user asks to analyze a Sentry issue, investigate a crash, or review unresolved GnollHack errors. Covers data retrieval via Sentry MCP tools, structured analysis of stack traces, breadcrumbs, debug buffers, and game state, cross-event pattern recognition, and drawing evidence-based conclusions with confidence levels. Emphasizes avoiding false diagnoses.
